messages:
deploy-bot: Canary deploy -> /prompt-router/v3-new-endpoint 2/10 failed: 15% 500s in last 3m. Rolling 2->0 if no ack in 2m. :rotating_light:

maria (oncall): seeing the alert. paging @mike and @sam. any immediate mitigation? did the canary hit prod traffic spike?

sam (platform): looks like requests with long-context (~6k tokens) are hitting new kernel path and OOM'ing. Canary is small but errors spike on a few routes. I'm on it.

mike (pager): on pager duty, joining. what's the FF key for the new endpoint?

sam (platform): ff: feature_prompt_mux_new_ep. I can flip a slice back to stable. recommend kill-slice (0) to stop routing to v3 endpoint. who will trigger? I can if we want immediate.

maria (oncall): please go ahead, flip it. tell me when done. also run a quick check to confirm KV cache warm isn't the root cause.

sam (platform): executing.

sam (platform): /api/flags/set feature_prompt_mux_new_ep 0 --scope=canary

deploy-bot: Feature flag update detected: feature_prompt_mux_new_ep -> 0 (actor: sam). Traffic route snapshot will update within 30s.

envoy-metrics-bot: 30s snapshot: 500s on /v3-new-endpoint dropped from 15% -> 0.8%. Overall prompt-router 2% -> 0.6%. Latency back to baseline. :white_check_mark:

mike (pager): confirmed drop in errors. taking ownership for next 30m to monitor. scheduling handoff to tina in 25m.

maria (oncall): great. any customer-facing errors? CS, please assess.

cs-bot: CS alert: 3 customers reported intermittent failures in last 10m (tickets #C-1023, #C-1024, #C-1025). Estimated impacted reqs: ~0.02% of total traffic. Suggest outbound only if customers ask. :email:

mike (pager): noted. I've posted a short incident note to status page draft. no public message for now unless CS wants.

sam (platform): root cause preliminary: new kernel path for long-context requests causes memory spike under certain tokenization alignment. rollout halted. Plan: revert code path in next deploy and add alignment guard. create bug and link.

maria (oncall): create the bug and assign to runtime eng. Action items: 1) sam - bug + rollback patch. 2) runtime - add guard + test. 3) oncall - monitor for 60m. 4) cs - hold for inbound only. I'll update postmortem template afterwards.

sam (platform): bug created: RUNTIME-4821. rollback PR in progress. ETA 2h for patch and canary.

tina (oncall): thanks @mike, I'll take monitoring at +25m. ping me if anything flares.

mike (pager): handoff done. leaving thread to tina. :hand:

tina (oncall): taking over. dashboard green. watching 0.5% error rate for 30m.

maria (oncall): closing active page. file incident record and assign postmortem. thanks team. :bow:

cs-bot: CS updated tickets with note: "Issue traced to experimental endpoint, temporary routing removed, engineering is working on fix." customers notified.

maria (oncall): final status: emergency FF kill succeeded, customer impact limited, next steps logged. last observation window end: +25m clean. closing thread.
